title.narrative: Contribution to the Danish Church Aid project "Responsible Business Conduct in East Africa"

description.narrative: "Responsible business conduct in East Africa: Strengthening a multi-stakeholder approach to the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights in Ethiopia and Uganda" is a two-year project with an aim to strengthen multi-stakeholder approaches to the implementation and monitoring of the UNGPs in Uganda and Ethiopia through development of CSO capacity and establish a good practice model for meaningful participation of local right-holders and CSOs in UNGP implementation and monitoring.

title.narrative: Uganda: Relevant State, business and CSO actors have strengthened capacity on multi-stakeholder collaboration on implementation and monitoring of UNGPs activities.
Select CSOs demonstrate enhanced capacity to engage in activities and monitoring of implementations to secure RBC.

target.value: 1. One annual Multi stakeholder platform on the state of RBC with State, private sector and CSOs. 2. Profiling key case studies arising out of the collaboration between Global South & North partnerships amongst businesses inspiring, learn and act for RBC (Revised to Enabling adoption of NAP through stakeholder engagement/partnerships w/ policymakers). 3. Annual reviews on the status of key regulatory frameworks (development and implementation) (Revised to Shadow report analysis of draft NAPs). 4. Documentation of lessons and good practices from the collaboration between the different stakeholders on RBC in Uganda (Revised to Case development and BHR multi-stakeholder platform for dialogue enabled).

actual.value: 1. 3rd Annual symposium on BHR in Uganda co-hosted. 2. Case study developed. 3. RRA key partners in enabling CSO consultations and input to draft NAPs. 4. One multi-stakeholder roundtable held in Addis including relevant State business and CSO actors (output target postponed to 2022).

title.narrative: National level implementation of the UNGPs in Ethiopia and Uganda.
Civil society actors and other relevant stakeholders express increasing capacity and possibility to advance global normative standards on RBC in the practical implementation at local level.

target.value: Documented engagement by CSOs in policy development in Uganda and multi-stakeholder dialogue on potential policy development in Ethiopia.

actual.value: The project has through a CSO-lead multi-stakeholder engagement approach enabled an inclusive platform to discuss policy developments on business related human rights violations in Uganda and in East Africa.

title.narrative: International awareness and good practice dissemination.
Good practice models on multi-stakeholder engagement for UNGP implementation demonstrated and shared through publication of case studies and engagement at international level.

target.value: Good practice model for initiation of systematic multistakeholder engagements in Ethiopia and Uganda on business and human rights related issues.

actual.value: Another significant achievement was the development and dissemination of a good practice case study. This document showcased successful approaches to BHR and responsible business conduct in Uganda, capturing valuable lessons and insights from the collaboration between global south and north partnerships. Additionally, a country strategy for the multi-stakeholder model, based on the scoping study and experiences in Uganda, was developed and shared.
